title: Pet Car Seatbelt 2 Pack, Adjustable Nylon Harness Lead
bullets: Two-piece set, per the maker's 2PC listing.
Adjustable length from 16.93 to 27.17 inches (430 to 690 mm).
Nylon strap, 0.98 inches (25 mm) wide, per the maker.
Attach to a harness, not a collar. Not a crash restraint.
description:
Riding with a dog or cat in the car is easier with a tether you can adjust to fit. This 2-pack of pet car seatbelts has an adjustable length of 16.93 to 27.17 inches (430 to 690 mm) and a 0.98-inch (25 mm) wide strap, according to the maker's specifications. The maker lists the material as premium nylon, and the specification shows black. The listed weight for the pack is 454 g, about 1 lb.

Attach this seatbelt to a well-fitted harness, not a collar. It is not a crash restraint. Check the adjustment and harness fit before every trip, and keep your pet supervised in the vehicle at all times.

Ships from a US warehouse, and the shipping window is listed in the FAQ below.

faq.a: No. It is not a crash restraint. Attach it to a well-fitted harness and keep your pet supervised in the vehicle.

Estimate: 3–5 days to the US after 1–3 days of processing. Ships from a US warehouse.
